_comment: Three stages: the agent's terminal, the merchant screen, the payer's phone. Every line narrates the exact thing on screen at that moment. ~165 words ≈ 58s at Louis's pace.

beats.cue: /stage/terminal — command types itself, real agent output streams in, APPROVE highlighted
beats.text: This is a shopping agent buying a T-shirt. Its AI brain checks the deal, approves it, and pays. Real Singapore dollars, live on Avalanche. Now watch what makes this payment different.
lines: This is a shopping agent, buying a T-shirt.
Its AI brain checks the deal, approves it — and pays.
Real Singapore dollars, live on Avalanche.
Now watch what makes this payment different.

beats.cue: cut to merchant screen — order card + countdown ring
beats.text: This is the shop's screen. The payment has already arrived, signed and locked. But it comes with a built-in pause: for ninety seconds, the shop cannot collect it.
lines: This is the shop's screen. The payment has arrived — signed and locked.
But it comes with a built-in pause:
for ninety seconds, the shop cannot collect it.

beats.cue: click SETTLE anyway — dark slab fills with the revert
beats.text: Let the shop try anyway. The money itself refuses. That answer came from the token contract on the blockchain — not from any server of ours.
lines: Let the shop try anyway —
the money itself refuses.
That answer came from the token contract. Not from us.

beats.cue: cut to the phone — countdown + red button, then the tap, then CANCELLED
beats.text: Meanwhile, this is your phone. Changed your mind? One tap. That cancellation just went on-chain, permanently. The shop can never collect that payment.
lines: Meanwhile — this is your phone.
Changed your mind? One tap.
That cancellation just went on-chain. Permanently.

beats.cue: back to the merchant screen — balance bars, deltas at zero
beats.text: And here is the part that matters: your balance never moved. There is nothing to refund, because the money never left your wallet.
lines: And here's the part that matters:
your balance never moved.
Nothing to refund — the money never left your wallet.

beats.cue: scroll to on-chain events — AuthorizationUsed (auto-settled earlier order) glows next to AuthorizationCanceled
beats.text: And when you don't object? Amazon's scheduler settles it for you, right on time, and it is final. There is the earlier order — settled on its own, no chargebacks, ever.
lines: And when you don't object?
Amazon's scheduler settles it for you, right on time. Final.
There's the earlier order — settled on its own. No chargebacks, ever.

beats.text: GRACE. Nobody ever held your money. Nobody had to.
lines: GRACE. Nobody ever held your money. Nobody had to.
